newsitem.title: UK: UK's Amersham to merge with Norway's Nycomed.
newsitem.headline: UK's Amersham to merge with Norway's Nycomed.

text.p: British health and technology group Amersham International Plc, fresh from a drug discovery merger with Sweden's Pharmacia Biotech, said on Tuesday it planned to merge with Norway's Nycomed ASA.

Amersham said the deal would create a global group, capitalised at around 1.8 billion pounds ($3 billion), with a leading position in in-vivo diagnostic imaging agents and research-based biotechnology supply.

Amersham said the new group, to be named Amersham Nycomed Plc, would have combined pro-forma revenues before restructuring charges of 1.5 billion pounds ($2.5 billion) and operating profits of 244 million.
It said the deal was conditional on the completion of its merger with Pharmacia Biotech, which was announced last month.

Under the terms of the merger, Nycomed shareholders will receive new shares in Amersham representing around 53 percent of the enlarged share capital of the new group. Amersham shareholders will own 47 percent.

Nycomed shareholders will also be given a special dividend of 5.62 crowns (76 cents) for each share held, Amersham said, adding that the merger was expected to yield annual pre-tax savings of at least 40 million pounds in the first three years.
